display.label: AWS EC2 Image Builder
display.description: Automate the creation, testing, and deployment of golden virtual machine AMIs using EC2 Image Builder

globals.label: AWS Region
globals.description: The AWS region where resources will be provisioned.

resource.key_description: Unique identifier name for the Image Builder pipeline. Serves as map key.

fields.label: Pipeline Name
fields.description: Unique name identifier for the Image Builder pipeline.

validation.pattern_error: Name must contain only alphanumeric characters, dashes, and underscores.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: Description of the Image Builder pipeline.
fields.placeholder: Builds and tests hardened golden images

fields.label: Pipeline Status
fields.description: Whether the pipeline is actively enabled.

fields.label: Parent Image
fields.description: Base image ARN or AMI ID (e.g. arn:aws:imagebuilder:us-east-1:aws:image/amazon-linux-2-x86/x.x.x).

fields.label: Recipe Version
fields.description: Semantic version for the image recipe.

fields.label: Build Components
fields.description: List of Image Builder component ARNs to apply during build.

sections.label: Infrastructure Configuration
sections.description: EC2 instance sizing, IAM profile, and VPC networking for build instances.

fields.label: IAM Instance Profile Name
fields.description: IAM instance profile name attached to the build instance (must have EC2ImageBuilderProfile policies).

fields.label: Instance Types
fields.description: List of EC2 instance types to use for build machines.

fields.label: Subnet ID
fields.description: VPC Subnet ID where build instances will be launched.

fields.label: Security Group IDs
fields.description: List of security group IDs for build instances.

fields.label: EC2 Key Pair
fields.description: SSH key pair name for troubleshooting build instances.

fields.label: Terminate on Failure
fields.description: Whether to automatically terminate build instances when the pipeline fails.

fields.label: SNS Topic ARN
fields.description: SNS Topic ARN for build status notifications.

sections.label: Pipeline Schedule
sections.description: Automated schedule expression for regular image builds.

fields.label: Schedule Expression
fields.description: Cron or rate expression (e.g., cron(0 0 ? * SUN *) or rate(7 days)).

sections.label: Tags
sections.description: Resource tags assigned to Image Builder resources.

fields.label: Resource Tags
fields.description: Key-value tags assigned to all created resources.
